name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's journey into motorsport HR began unconventionally. After graduating with a business degree, he initially worked in human resources for a large electronics manufacturer. However, a lifelong passion for racing, ignited by watching Formula One as a child, led him to volunteer at local motorsport events. He quickly recognized the potential for applying his HR expertise within the racing world. 

He joined Walkenhorst Motorsport five years ago, bringing a structured and empathetic approach to talent management. Kenji focuses on creating a supportive and inclusive environment, believing a happy team is a winning team. He's known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to mediate conflicts effectively, ensuring the team operates smoothly under pressure. His background outside of motorsport HR gives him unique insight into the challenges and opportunities within the team.

Kenji constantly seeks innovative ways to improve employee satisfaction and retention. He implements regular feedback sessions and career development programs, demonstrating his commitment to fostering a positive and productive workplace. He's a strong advocate for diversity within the team, understanding its importance for innovation and competitiveness.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Kenji has a warm smile and wears rectangular glasses that give him a studious look.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn copy of the company handbook.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses when deep in thought.
Prefers to conduct meetings while standing.
